scriptLines: prepararLista flatten(unroll(ListaRutas as RutaExpandida), cross: false) ~> expandirRutas

RutaHistoricaId = iif(isNull(RutaExpandida) || trim(RutaExpandida) == '', toString(null()), iif(regexMatch(upper(trim(RutaExpandida)), '^RH-'), upper(trim(RutaExpandida)), iif(upper(trim(RutaExpandida)) == 'R12-N', 'RH-12-N', iif(upper(trim(RutaExpandida)) == 'R12-S', 'RH-12-S', iif(lpad(replace(replace(replace(upper(trim(RutaExpandida)), 'RUTA ', ''), 'R-', ''), ' ', ''), 2, '0') == '07', 'RH-07-OLD', iif(lpad(replace(replace(replace(upper(trim(RutaExpandida)), 'RUTA ', ''), 'R-', ''), ' ', ''), 2, '0') == '12', 'RH-12-OLD', concat('RH-', lpad(replace(replace(replace(upper(trim(RutaExpandida)), 'RUTA ', ''), 'R-', ''), ' ', ''), 2, '0')))))))),

EsPrincipal = iif(isNull(EsPrincipal) || trim(EsPrincipal) == '', iif(trim(RutaExpandida) == trim(split(RutaHistoricaId, '\\|')[1]), true(), false()), iif(trim(EsPrincipal) == '1' || lower(trim(EsPrincipal)) == 'true', true(), false()))) ~> limpiar
